message:
Let me look at the fuzzer.mk to understand how the fuzzer is built, and check if there's a pre-built binary:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server/src/bin/fuzzer.mk && echo "===" && find /workspace/repo-vul -name "fuzzer_tacacs" -type f 2>/dev/null && find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.a" -path "*tacacs*" 2>/dev/null</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
